heading: Israeli raids, attacks, arrests continue in occupied West Bank and Gaza
body: Settler raids and attacks in the occupied West Bank, often under Israeli police protection, continued on Friday.

heading: More Araghchi quotes from call with UK counterpart
body: We now have more quotes from Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi during his phone call with UK Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband, according to Iran’s Tasnim news.

heading: WATCH: The US faces a strategic ‘dead end’ in Iran, analyst says
body: Washington has reached a strategic impasse with Iran, says a former analyst for the US Congress.

heading: WATCH: Israeli settlers vandalise Palestinian cemetery in West Bank
body: Israeli settlers vandalised a Palestinian cemetery, smashing stonework marking the graves of deceased Palestinians, during a march near the village of Tal in the occupied West Bank.

heading: US faces critical shortage of missile defence interceptors: Report
body: Months of conflict in the Middle East have left the Pentagon facing a diminishing supply of missile defence interceptors, prompting military planners to consider whether the US can maintain its current cadence of retaliatory strikes, Fox News reports.

heading: Is Israel really ready to withdraw from Gaza?
body: Thursday’s agreement stipulating that Hamas disarm and Israel withdraw from Gaza has gotten a frosty reception from Israeli politicians and the Israeli press.

heading: Photos: Israeli settlers march through Tal, Sarra in occupied West Bank
body: Israeli settlers march through the occupied West Bank village of Tal, near Nablus, on July 31 [Majdi Mohammed/AP]

heading: Kuwaiti army says intercepting ‘hostile drones’
body: The Kuwaiti army says its air defences are currently countering “hostile drone attacks”.

heading: Heavy explosions rock southern Lebanon as Israeli forces conduct patrols
body: Lebanon’s National News Agency (NNA) says southern villages and towns – particularly those in and near the Israeli-imposed “Yellow Zone”, including al-Mansouri, Majdal Zoun, and Haddatha – are in a state of high tension following huge explosions carried out by Israeli forces overnight.

heading: Israeli drone attack kills two in Gaza City
body: An Israeli drone attack has killed two people in Gaza City’s Sheikh Radwan neighbourhood, according to the Wafa news agency, citing al-Shifa Hospital where the casualties were taken.

heading: Kuwait reports damage, but no casualties after drone attack
body: Kuwait’s military says it has “intercepted and destroyed” hostile drones that entered the country’s territory, after earlier reporting activating its air defences due to “Iranian aggression”.

heading: Iran says regional countries should reconsider ‘alignment’ with US
body: Iranian Major-General Ali Abdollahi, the commander of Iran’s top joint military command, the Khatam al-Anbiya Central Headquarters, has said the US actions against Iran increasingly risk igniting widespread regional conflict.

body: Reporting from Gaza City, Gaza

heading: Kuwait reserves right to ‘take all measures’ to protect security after drone attack
body: Kuwait’s Foreign Ministry has condemned Iran’s “continued aggression” against it after a drone attack earlier today targeted “vital installations”.

heading: US urges its citizens in Middle East to ‘exercise caution’, calls Iran ‘unpredictable’
body: The US Embassy in Amman, Jordan has shared a security alert urging US citizens in the Middle East to be on heightened alert, saying the situation in the region is “fluid” and Iran’s government is “unpredictable”.

heading: Photos: Aftermath of attack on medical warehouse in Gaza’s Deir el-Balah
body: Palestinians inspect the site of an Israeli strike on a medicine warehouse, according to medics, next to tents sheltering displaced Palestinians, in Deir el-Balah, central Gaza, August 1 [Mahmoud Issa/Reuters]

heading: Israeli attack kills Palestinian near Khan Younis
body: Another Palestinian has been killed in an Israeli attack on southern Gaza, according to our colleagues on the ground.

heading: ‘Heinous crime’: Gaza’s Health Ministry denounces Israeli attack on hospital’s warehouses
body: Gaza’s Health Ministry has condemned what it calls a “heinous crime” by Israeli forces in Deir el-Balah, saying the attack early this morning targeted “medicine warehouses” belonging to Al-Aqsa Martyrs Hospital, completely destroying two of them.

heading: Israeli settlers attack Palestinian couple in occupied West Bank
body: Israeli settlers have assaulted a Palestinian man and his wife while they were at their farm in the village of Beitillu, northwest of Ramallah, in the occupied West Bank, according to the Wafa news agency.

body: Reporting from Gaza City, Gaza

body: Reporting from Gaza City, Gaza

body: The Israeli army and its security agency Shin Bet have claimed they destroyed five Hamas weapon depots in the Gaza Strip overnight.

heading: Iran planning for worst-case scenarios amid ongoing conflict, official says
body: Iran’s First Vice President Mohammad Reza Aref has been quoted by the semi-official Fars news agency as saying that the country is preparing supplies for the next two years, without elaborating on the types of supplies.

heading: Israel strikes town of Nabatieh al-Fawqa in southern Lebanon
body: An Israeli drone strike has struck the town of Nabatieh al-Fawqa in southern Lebanon, according to our colleagues at Al Jazeera Arabic.

heading: WATCH: Children run marathon to spotlight Gaza’s growing orphan crises
body: Hundreds of children took part in a marathon in Gaza to raise awareness of the growing number of children who have lost one or both parents during Israel’s genocidal war on the enclave.

heading: 21 children among 152 Palestinians killed in Gaza in July: Ministry
body: Gaza’s Ministry of Health has said 152 people were reported killed last month, marking the highest number since the beginning of the year.

heading: Iran ‘does not underestimate’ US actions in the region
body: Mohammad Eslami, a research fellow in Middle East and North Africa studies at the University of Tehran has told Al Jazeera that “there are some kind of back channel negotiations between the Iranians and the Americans with the help of the mediators”.

heading: UN says Israeli demolitions in southern Lebanon raise ‘grave concern’
body: The Office of the United Nations Special Coordinator for Lebanon (UNSCOL) has warned that ongoing Israeli demolitions in southern Lebanon raise “grave concern”, due to the “devastating effects they leave on civilian infrastructure, cultural heritage, and the collective memory of the local communitie

heading: Gaza health ministry, doctors warn of catastrophic shortages amid attacks
body: Israel is continuing to attack Gaza’s hospitals and key warehouses storing available resources, despite a “ceasefire” agreement signed in October purportedly allowing humanitarian aid to enter Gaza.

heading: US renews travel warning for Middle East region, warns of possible escalation
body: The US Department of State has issued a travel warning for the entire Middle East region, saying “Americans in the region should consider departing, or be prepared to depart should there be escalation.”

heading: Lebanon army chief says ‘every inch of our land is our right’
body: Lebanese Army Commander General Rodolph Haykal has stressed the need to ensure the country’s territorial integrity, as Israel continues to occupy about 2,000sq km (770sq miles) of southern Lebanon’s territory.

body: US President Donald Trump has claimed that Iran is experiencing “massive inflation”.

heading: Palestinian children among those detained in Israeli West Bank raids
body: Seven Palestinians, including two children, have been detained by Israeli forces in overnight and predawn raids across the West Bank, according to Palestinian local sources.
